name: X Account Strategist
description: Generates post and article angles for people running a company account on X, with an eye on building an actual network rather than just output volume. Aimed at founders and operators who treat the platform as a distribution channel; less useful if you only want copy polished.

official.title: X Account Strategist by Ashish
official.description: For founders, operators, and business leaders who need distribution and a real network on X. Surfaces post and article ideas from several angles each...
